authorization: auth.uid must be non-null before any write
private.is_platform_owner verifies profiles.id=auth.uid, global_role=platform_owner, role=platform_super_admin, coalesced active status
Enable path: authoring lock, published textbook/version/chapter, student_app association, source locks, grammar validity, exact snapshot equality
Insert/update CAS with revision; unique app/chapter binding
Disable path: Owner guard plus app/chapter/revision CAS; does not require source published revalidation
tenantPolicy: Platform-owner authoring RPC; no tenant student self-read contract and no authorization merely because SQL role=service_role.
mutationCapability: Writes chapter_practice_bindings as definer; not a Lesson Tool read API.
serviceRoleSecuritySurface: Extra EXECUTE permits entry into a privileged mutating function, but bypassrls does not bypass explicit auth.uid and owner predicate. Ordinary service credentials with no subject fail the first check (static analysis only). A caller able to assert a real active owner subject can satisfy it; no service-role exclusion exists. Do not label extra grant harmless or necessary merely from role name.
leastPrivilegeDecision: No product service-role requirement found. Guarded historical persistence does not by itself establish intentional least-privilege policy.
